6118.title: Child execution defaults bypass parent history
6118.rootCauseOneLine: Creation chooses provider and execution defaults without consulting the validated parent's last execution; only permission policy consumes parent history.
6118.proposedFix: Resolve matching parent provider, model and reasoning at creation before project defaults; preserve explicit overrides and existing permission policy.
6118.caveats: Server creation/start-command reproduction with real migrated SQLite and provider registrations; no account-backed provider or original private runtime was accessed. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent.
